purpose: Controlled full-basin HEC-HMS experiments for G040. Change one process family at a time so improvements can be attributed physically.

forcing.observed: hourly accumulated precipitation; all valid gauges; missing never zero; spatial field preserved
forcing.forecast: ECMWF/IFS full spatial field; cycle and lead time preserved

Alto Taquari-Antas.name: PCH SERRA DOS CAVALINHOS I BARRAMENTO

Prata.name: UHE MONTE CLARO BALSA DO PRATA

Carreiro.name: PASSO CARREIRO
Carreiro.role: observed boundary already tested in Muçum architecture

Médio Taquari-Antas.name: LINHA JOSÉ JÚLIO
Médio Taquari-Antas.role: observed upstream boundary validated in Muçum architecture

Baixo Taquari-Antas.name: RIO TAQUARI (Triunfo)
Baixo Taquari-Antas.role: near-outlet validation; hydraulic backwater sensitivity required

experiments.name: Legacy reference reproduction
experiments.objective: Reproduce the July-2026 145-subbasin/72-reach baseline before changing physics.
experiments.promotion_gate: native geometry/topology recovered or independently reconstructed and verified

experiments.name: Legacy physics plus observed branch state
experiments.state_update: documented observed non-overlapping branch boundaries/state controls
experiments.objective: Isolate the benefit of state/boundary information without changing rainfall-runoff formulation.
experiments.promotion_gate: no visual stage shifting; native model state must pass branch-wise checks

experiments.name: Continuous SMA plus Clark
experiments.baseflow: Recession or sourced groundwater formulation selected by validation
experiments.state_update: continuous warm-up plus observed boundary updates where justified
experiments.objective: Test whether explicit antecedent soil/groundwater state improves volume, rise, recession and transfer across events.

experiments.name: Continuous SMA plus ModClark
experiments.baseflow: same selected formulation as E2 for controlled comparison
experiments.objective: Test added value of preserving within-subbasin spatial rainfall/runoff timing from the gridded forcing.

experiments.name: Selected HEC-HMS 2D diffusion-wave transform pilots
experiments.loss: selected best continuous loss from E2/E3
experiments.transform: 2D Diffusion Wave only in selected verified domains
experiments.objective: Test whether explicit 2D runoff routing adds skill in selected flood-prone/complex subbasins; not a blanket basin-wide replacement.

experiments.name: Hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling
experiments.objective: Convert branch/trunk hydrographs to stage, velocity, depth and inundation, especially in the lower Taquari.
requirements: downstream boundary including Jacuí/Guaíba backwater when relevant

evaluation.acceptance_rule: No variant is promoted from a single event or a single control station.

interpretation_order: E0 must reproduce the legacy model
E3 tests added gridded transform detail
E4 tests 2D diffusion only where justified
E5 adds hydraulic stage/inundation after hydrologic skill is established
